summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share transactions by board members, executives, and associated persons under EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses two gifts of Novo Nordisk B shares received by Caroline Munk Esbjerg (50 shares at DKK 294.30 each) and Sofie Munk Esbjerg (50 shares at DKK 294.25 each), both closely associated with the CFO. There are no corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure of insider transactions and does not constitute a special situation.
